metadata.description: Reads GitHub repository, issue, pull request, code, release, collaboration, Actions, security (code scanning/dependabot/secret scanning/advisories), webhook, deploy key, environment, and ruleset data, and plans approval-gated reverse ETL actions through fixed GitHub REST and GraphQL operations.
metadata.name: github

risk.approval: reverse ETL plan approval required before writes

auth_type.description: Authentication selector used by rendered auth and rate-limit policies. Use 'token' or 'oauth' for a personal or OAuth token, 'github_app' for an installation token, 'github_token' for the GitHub Actions token, or 'public', 'none', 'anonymous', or 'unauthenticated' for explicitly unauthenticated traffic. App configuration identified by app_id is normalized to the GitHub App installation policy.

base_url.description: GitHub API base URL override for tests or GitHub Enterprise.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID for auth_type=github_app.

installation_permissions.description: Optional JSON object of requested GitHub App installation-token permissions.

installation_repositories.description: Optional comma-separated repository names for a restricted installation token.

installation_repository_ids.description: Optional comma-separated repository IDs for a restricted installation token.

owner.description: Repository owner (user or organization login). Owner and repository are separate keys so each path-template value is encoded as one bounded path segment.

private_key.description: GitHub App PEM private key for auth_type=github_app. Never logged.

private_key_base64.description: Base64-encoded GitHub App PEM private key for auth_type=github_app (alternative to private_key). Never logged.

public_access.description: Explicit opt-in for unauthenticated public reads. Set to a non-empty value to allow reads without token or app credentials. When this and an unauthenticated auth_type are absent, the runtime requires a token or complete GitHub App credentials and fails closed.

rate_limit_account.description: Authenticated GitHub user login used only as the non-secret coordination subject for auth_type=token or oauth rate limits. It is not a token and need not match the target repository owner.

rate_limit_ip.description: Originating public IP address used only as the non-secret coordination subject for unauthenticated GitHub rate limits.

rate_limit_repository.description: Repository identity in owner/repo form used only as the non-secret coordination subject for auth_type=github_token GitHub Actions rate limits.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix.

since.description: Lower-bound timestamp for issues, issue_comments, and pull_request_review_comments (incremental start; also usable as a fresh-sync start_config_key value).

token.description: GitHub token: classic PAT, fine-grained PAT, OAuth token, GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN, or a pre-generated installation access token. Used only for Bearer auth; never logged.

schemas/languages.json.description: GitHub's /languages endpoint returns a single JSON object keyed by language name with byte-count values (e.g. {"Go": 123456, "Shell": 890}), an arbitrary/dynamic key set (not a fixed set of named properties) — this stream declares projection:passthrough so every language key is preserved verbatim rather than dropped by schema-mode's fixed-property projection (records.keyed_object does not apply here since the values are bare integers, not objects). One record per repository.

repository.description: Config-derived per-record marker field ("owner/repo"); the only statically-declared property. All other emitted fields are the dynamic per-language byte counts, passed through verbatim.

graphql.document: query ViewDiscussion($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $number: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { discussion(number: $number) { id number title body url isAnswered answerChosenAt createdAt updatedAt author { login } category { id name slug } comments(first: 20) { totalCount nodes { id body url isAnswer createdAt updatedAt author { login } } } } } }

command.notes: Views one repository discussion using a fixed GraphQL query. Private repositories require repo scope; public repositories require public_repo scope.

graphql.document: query ListDiscussions($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { discussions(first: $first, after: $after, orderBy: {field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC}) { nodes { id number title url isAnswered answerChosenAt createdAt updatedAt author { login } category { id name slug } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } }

command.notes: Lists repository discussions using a fixed GraphQL query. Private repositories require repo scope; public repositories require public_repo scope.

graphql.document: query ListProjectItems($projectId: ID!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { node(id: $projectId) { ... on ProjectV2 { id number title items(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id type createdAt updatedAt content { __typename ... on Issue { id number title url state } ... on PullRequest { id number title url state } } } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } }

command.notes: Lists items for a Project v2 node ID using a fixed GraphQL query. Private projects require read:project scope.

graphql.document: query ListProjects($owner: String!, $repo: String!, $first: Int!, $after: String) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $repo) { owner { __typename login ... on Organization { projectsV2(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id number title url closed updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } ... on User { projectsV2(first: $first, after: $after) { nodes { id number title url closed updatedAt } pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor } } } } } }

command.notes: Lists Projects v2 for the configured repository owner using a fixed GraphQL query. Private projects require read:project scope.
